lines.t:
The <c:ffff00>{{slot}}<c> equivalent to the {{lower_body}} that supports
a <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c>. It has a <c:ffff00>Leg Type<c>, a <c:ffff00>Leg Trait<c>, a <c:ffff00>Heavy<c>
<c:ffff00>Limit<c> and these <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c>: <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{mobility}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c>,
<c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c>.
It is the foundation of a {{medabot}} and greatly affects
the other slots. As a <c:ffff00>{{response}}<c> to an <c:ffff00>attack<c>, most
legs can <c:ffff00>evade<c>, but <c:ffff00>{{tank}}<c> types can only <c:ffff00>defend<c>.
When the <c:ffff00>{{charge_gauge}}<c> fills, {{mobility}}, {{fighting}} and
{{shooting}} rise.
